deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Fall 2027; earlier is encouraged for fellowship chances.
deadline.quote: Our application deadline for the Fall 2027 semester is December 1, 2026, but we strongly encourage earlier submission to maximize opportunities for fellowships.

gre_subject.value: Neither the GRE General nor the Chemistry GRE is required; don't send scores.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores (general or subject) are not required. Please do not submit them.

gre_general.value: GRE General is not required; the department asks you not to submit it.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores (general or subject) are not required. Please do not submit them.

toefl_min.value: Because every PhD student must TA, Chemistry needs TOEFL iBT 5 overall and 5 speaking on the new scale (103 and 24 speaking on the old scale). Duolingo is not accepted.
toefl_min.quote: Minimum TOEFL iBT (after January 1, 2026): 5 overall, 5 on the speaking subsection | Minimum TOEFL iBT (before January 1, 2026): 103 overall, 24 on the speaking subsection

ielts_min.value: IELTS 7.5 overall, 8 in speaking and at least 6 in every section.
ielts_min.quote: Minimum IELTS: 7.5 overall, 8 on speaking subsection, no less than 6 on any subsection

supervisor.value: Students pick a research advisor during the first year, from any chemistry faculty member, after admission.
supervisor.quote: Students generally select a research advisor and begin research during their first year of graduate school. Once admitted as a graduate student in chemistry, a student may choose to work with any faculty member in the Department of Chemistry.

funding.value: All full-time PhD students in good standing get year-round support: tuition waiver, health insurance and a salary (mostly TA first, RA later).
funding.quote: The Department of Chemistry provides year-round financial support to all full-time Ph.D. students in good academic standing.

entry_route.value: A four-year bachelor's degree (US equivalent) is the entry requirement.
entry_route.quote: Undergraduate Degree (must be the equivalent of a 4-year Bachelor's Degree in the U.S.)

notes: TA duty is required of all PhD students, hence higher English minimums. Fee is USD 90 for all applicants; the department cannot waive it.
